content:wysiwyg_basic:2:95.name: WYSIWYG
content:wysiwyg_basic:2:95.html:
Who We Are

The Salvation Army Women's Auxiliary is the local expression of a worldwide movement that seeks spiritual redemption and social rehabilitation of those it serves. We function as a fundraising and volunteer service group and have many projects and programs that satisfy an eagerness to volunteer. The purpose of the auxiliary is to raise public awareness of The Salvation Army, facilitate services to the needy, and strengthen the financial base of the local Salvation Army.
